name: Child combinator
meaning: The > selector relationship matches an element directly inside the selected parent.

name: Attribute selector
meaning: A selector that checks whether an HTML attribute exists or matches a value pattern.

name: Type-specific position
meaning: nth-of-type counts sibling elements of the same type rather than all sibling types.

name: Generated pseudo-element
meaning: A styled generated part of an element, such as the decorative box selected by ::before.

name: Zero-specificity selector
meaning: :where() matches its arguments without adding their specificity.

name: Unset reset
meaning: The unset keyword inherits an inherited property, otherwise it uses that property’s initial value.

name: Font-relative length
meaning: An em or rem length uses a font-size reference rather than a fixed pixel count.

name: Calculated length
meaning: calc() combines compatible CSS quantities into a property value.

name: Unitless line height
meaning: A line-height number that scales with each inheriting element’s own font size.

name: Emergency text wrapping
meaning: overflow-wrap can permit breaks inside long text when ordinary breaks are insufficient.

name: Text presentation
meaning: Font and alignment properties change appearance without replacing HTML meaning.

name: List marker
meaning: A visual symbol or counter associated with a list item.

name: Compound class selector
meaning: Joined class selectors require one element to have all the named classes.

name: Declaration recovery
meaning: A browser can discard an invalid CSS declaration while keeping other valid declarations in the rule.

name: Non-color link cue
meaning: An underline or other visible signal helps identify a link without relying only on color.

name: background positioning
meaning: Positioning chooses where a background image is painted.

name: linear-gradient()
meaning: A CSS function producing a linear gradient image.

name: box-shadow
meaning: A shadow paints a box without increasing its layout dimensions.

name: margin collapse
meaning: Some vertical block margins combine into one margin.

name: flow-root
meaning: A display value establishing a block formatting context.

name: intrinsic sizing
meaning: Sizing based on content rather than only a fixed dimension.

name: object-fit
meaning: Controls fitting of replaced content inside its box.

name: relative positioning
meaning: Visual displacement that preserves the original flow space.

name: fixed containing block
meaning: The reference box used to place a fixed-position element.

name: sticky positioning
meaning: Flow-preserving positioning constrained by a scrollport inset and containing block.

name: cross-axis alignment
meaning: Alignment perpendicular to the flex container’s main axis.

name: named grid area
meaning: A rectangular set of grid cells identified by a name.

name: implicit grid track
meaning: A track created outside the explicitly declared grid.

name: grid content alignment
meaning: Placement of grid tracks within available container space.

name: Custom-property fallback
meaning: The fallback argument supplies tokens when the referenced custom property cannot supply them.

name: Feature query
meaning: An @supports rule applies enclosed declarations when its support condition matches.

name: State transition
meaning: A CSS transition interpolates a property change over a duration when the property supports it.

name: Preferred color scheme
meaning: A media preference can select author styles while color-scheme informs browser-provided appearance.

name: Print stylesheet
meaning: Rules under @media print apply to print presentation rather than ordinary screen layout.

name: CSS diagnosis
meaning: A debugging sequence separates loading, matching, validity, cascade and layout questions.

name: Font-face loading
meaning: @font-face associates a CSS face name and descriptors with a font resource.

name: Hidden layout space
meaning: Visibility can hide painting while display:none removes an element’s layout box.

name: Important layer reversal
meaning: Important declarations use the opposite layer order from normal declarations within an origin.

name: Mobile-first enhancement
meaning: A narrow base layout gains space-dependent enhancements through minimum-width queries.

name: Native control typography
meaning: Explicit font inheritance can align form-control text with its surrounding form.
